issues.description: Page is stuck in a perpetual loading/skeleton state showing 'Analyzing your room...' instead of rendering detected furniture items with keep/remove toggles. The pre_detection_result data is not being loaded or the loading state never resolves.
issues.element: Entire step-7c page content - room image with overlays, furniture toggles, Continue button
issues.root_cause: The page component at apps/web/app/design/step-7c/page.tsx is likely reading pre_detection_result from sessionStorage or a store, but the data is not present (either never set or key mismatch), causing the loading condition to never become false. The hydration errors in the console also suggest server/client mismatch, possibly from Math.random() or Date-based values used during SSR skeleton rendering.

issues.description: Multiple hydration errors: 'Text content does not match server-rendered HTML' and 'entire root will switch to client rendering'. This causes a full client re-render and may contribute to the stuck loading state.
issues.root_cause: The page or its components use values that differ between server and client render (e.g., Math.random() for skeleton widths, localStorage/sessionStorage access without useEffect guard, or dynamic timestamps). The console warning from step-3 shows 'width:5%' vs 'width:15%' confirming random width skeleton bars.

fixes.reason: If the loading state defaults to true and never gets set to false due to missing pre_detection_result data, the page stays in skeleton state forever. Defaulting to false will allow the page to render with whatever data is available (or empty state) instead of being stuck.
Defaulting isMounted to true prevents the server/client hydration mismatch that causes the 'Text content does not match server-rendered HTML' errors, which can cascade into broken loading states.
